articleTitle: Record-High Output Power from Single-Mode Fiber of 15xx-Nm Pumps for U-Band Raman Amplifiers
abstract: We demonstrate record-high power 15xx-nm Raman pumps of 0.78W fiber output at 35 °C, while keeping a single transverse mode using a low optical confinement laser chip consisting of multi-stacked GaInAsP/InP electric field control layers for U-band Raman amplifiers.

articleTitle: Increasing Output Power in 970 nm Broad Area Lasers via Longitudinal Current Profile Modification
abstract: We show experimentally that the longitudinal temperature variation in high power GaAs-based diode lasers can be halved via a modified longitudinal current profile, using customized devices with segmented contacts. Lateral carrier accumulation at the front facet also halves, whereas peak power increases by 17 %.

articleTitle: Controlling Coupling in TCC VCSEL with Lithographically Defined Cavities at 940nm
abstract: We report on detailed studies of coupling in transverse coupled cavity VCSEL arrays. 1×2 arrays with lithographic apertures exhibit splitting in emission spectra, characteristic to coherent coupling between emitters. Spectrally resolved near- and far-field show typical patterns corresponding to in-phase and anti-phase optical states.

articleTitle: Future Paths to Improved Semiconductor Laser Reliability in Data Communications Applications
abstract: Semiconductor lasers for data communications have historically been less reliable than the copper interconnects they replaced. This paper describes three methods for improving reliability, including a novel proposal to use high-speed device imaging to detect flaws in the laser prior to deployment.

articleTitle: 4 µm Surface-Emitting Quantum Cascade Laser Using Photonic Crystal Embedded by MBE Regrowth
abstract: We designed and fabricated the surface-emitting quantum cascade laser (QCL) using InGaAs photonic crystals (PCs) embedded with InP. In order to fabricate a PC close to the design value, we investigated the Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) regrowth method as the low size fluctuations process and succeeded in filling PCs without any voids. We fabricated the surface emitting QCL with MBE regrowth method and achieved the pulsed lasing operation emitting at around 4.6 µm.

articleTitle: 8×100Gbps O-band DWDM Transmitter Empowered by Comb Laser and Micro-ring Modulator Array for Optical Interconnects
abstract: We report the first 800 Gbps, O-band transmitter using quantum dot mode-locked laser as WDM source and 8-channel microrings as modulator for chip-chip optical interconnects, operating at 50 Gbaud PAM4 with 1.75 pJ/bit.

articleTitle: 25 Gbaud VCSEL with Reduced Temperature Dependence
abstract: We present the design and performance of a 25 Gbaud 850 nm VCSEL with reduced temperature dependence of threshold current and modulation bandwidth from −40 to 125 degrees Celsius using different composition InGaAs QWs in the active region to spectrally broaden the optical gain.

articleTitle: Watt-Class High Brightness Tapered Laser with Integrated Distributed Feedback Grating at 1550 nm
abstract: We present a Watt-class high brightness 1550 nm tapered laser with a monolithically integrated DFB grating which provides high power narrow linewidth light in a single chip. Over 2 W of single spatial- and spectral-mode power has been demonstrated with peak efficiencies over 30%.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared VCSELs with Structured Low Loss Tunnel Junctions
abstract: Electrically pumped vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs) operating at 3.4 μm are demonstrated using a low-loss buried tunnel junction (BTJ) based on a structured semi-metallic interface between GaSb and InAs/AlSb superlattice. In contrast to traditional BTJ VCSELs based on a structured interface between highly n- and p-doped layers, the new tunnel junction has orders of magnitude lower optical loss, while providing similar optical and current confinements. VCSEL operation is demonstrated in pulsed mode up to 20 °C.

articleTitle: Efficient, High Power, Low Chirp Electro-Absorption Modulated Laser Integrated with SOA for 50G PON Application
abstract: We report an EML-SOA emitting over 17.3dBm dynamic output with power consumption of 380mW at 52°C. It exhibits 8.3dB ER at 1.5Vpp., 0.12 chirp., clear eye opening at 50Gb/s., which makes it suitable for 50G-PON applications.

articleTitle: Effect of Bias Condition on Spin Polarization Modulation Response of VCSELs
abstract: We measure the spin polarization modulation responses of an InAlGaAs VCSEL using an optical spin injection technique. The results indicate that the bias condition particularly near polarization switching points affects the response shape due to abrupt change in effective dichroism and birefringence.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of 940-nm VCSELs Fabricated Over 200-mm GaAs- and Ge-Substrates
abstract: We report on the first fabricated and characterized full 200 mm VCSEL wafers. We investigate performance of nominally identical VCSEs, across 200 mm, grown on both GaAs and Ge-substrates. Germanium offers a reduction in bow compared to standard GaAs substrates typically used in AlGaAs-based VCSELs, providing a route to larger diameter wafers and longer emission wavelengths in this material system.

articleTitle: Aging Mechanisms of 800 nm Broad-Area Laser Diodes
abstract: The impact of oxygen concentrations less than 4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> on device reliability in Phosphorous-based 800 nm laser diodes was examined. Several aging mechanisms were observed, showing modifications to output power and sudden emitter failure probability due to changes in cavity loss and defect density.

articleTitle: Lateral Growth of DBR InGaAs/InP Lasers with Sub-Wavelength Thicknesses on (001) SOI by MOCVD
abstract: We reported dislocation-free and laterally grown 25 periods of InGaAs/InP quantum wells on SOI by lateral aspect ratio trapping. Lateral epitaxy was performed on patterned SOI with Si layer thickness of 480 nm and 750 nm. Room temperature lasing of Distributed Bragg Reflector lasers with low thresholds around 13 µJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was demonstrated on both SOI templates.

articleTitle: Backside-Emitted Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers without Regrowth or Indium-Tin-Oxide
abstract: Neither regrowth nor indium-tin-oxide was applied, backside-emitted photonic-crystal (PC) surface-emitting lasers were fabricated by direct and blanket metallization over the PC structure on frontside of wafer. Enhanced slope efficiencies were demonstrated and far-field patterns were discussed. Besides, photonic band-structure was reconstructed from angle-resolved spectral measurement.

articleTitle: Scaling of Single-Mode Surface-Emitting Lasers with a Perturbed Dirac-Cone
abstract: We show that there is a tight upper bound in the quality-factor differential between modes in a planar optical device, which can be achieved in a perturbed Dirac cone band structure. This result points to a new pathway in the scaling of photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers.

articleTitle: Phase Locking of an Array of Blue Laser Diodes
abstract: We demonstrate phase locking of a large group of blue emitters in an array of broad-area laser diodes with filtered optical feedback. Experimentally retrieved parameters from the far-field profile are compared to a theoretical simulation to assess the quality of beam combining.

articleTitle: High Gain 1.3 µm InP-based Quantum Dot Lasers
abstract: InP-based 1.3 µm QD lasers were realized with a modal gain of 15 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> per QD layer, an internal quantum efficiency of 0.89 along with a bandwidth of 10.9 GHz and a high temperature stability with a T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-value of more than 700 K.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Surface Emitting Lasers Across the Visible Spectrum Based on Colloidal Quantum Dots
abstract: Combining integrated optical platforms with solution processable semiconductor materials offers a clear path towards miniaturized and robust light sources, including lasers. Semiconducting colloidal quantum dots present a unique platform to realize this by combining tunable properties, high luminescence efficiency. A limiting aspect for both red and green emitting materials remains the drop in efficiency at high excitation density due to non-radiative quenching pathways, such as Auger recombination. Next to this, lasers based on such materials remain ill characterized, leaving questions on their ultimate performance. Here, we show that weakly confined ‘bulk’ colloidal quantum dots offer a unique solution processable materials platform to circumvent the long-standing material issues. Here, we first show that optical gain in such systems is mediated by a 3D plasma state of unbound electron-hole pairs which gives rise to broadband and sizable gain across the full red spectrum with record gain lifetimes and low threshold. As proof of concept, the nanocrystals are integrated on a silicon nitride platform enabling high spectral contrast, surface emitting and TE polarized PCSEL – type lasers with ultra-narrow beam divergence across the visible (green, red) spectrum from a small surface area. Our results prime QS materials as excellent materials platform to realize highly performant and compact on-chip light sources.

articleTitle: Impact of Wavelength, Strain, and Barrier Materials on the Recovery Dynamics of GaSb-Based SESAMs
abstract: We present a rigorous study on <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${2}\ \boldsymbol{\mu} {m}-{2.4}\ \boldsymbol{\mu} {m}$</tex> GaSb-based SESAMs, adjusting quantum well design and MBE growth parameters. We discover that strain-induced defects and barrier materials significantly affect recovery dynamics, revealing distinct mechanisms notably different from the well-studied GaAs-based SESAMs.

articleTitle: A Platform for Integrated Photonics
abstract: We report on essential elements of an integrated photonics platform based on InGaAs Quantum Dots with oxidizable AlGaAs layers and that is suitable for growth on Silicon. We focus on laser performance and also discuss an active-to-passive interface-coupler and an enhanced surface-grating-coupler.

articleTitle: Injection-Locked Whistle-Geometry Ring Laser Photonic Integrated Circuit
abstract: Photonic integrated circuit comprising a whistle-geometry ring laser, injecting waveguide, distributed-Bragg reflector master laser, outcoupling waveguides, and a monitoring ring photodetector has been fabricated and characterized.

articleTitle: Narrow Linewidth DBR Laser Incorporating with an Intra-Cavity Etalon
abstract: A novel DBR laser incorporating with an intracavity etalon has been developed and the narrow linewidth of 20 kHz was obtained. An output power of 60 mW and SMSR of 50 dB are achieved in full C-band with the laser module using SOA integrated chip.

articleTitle: Application of Frequency Stabilized Semiconductor Lasers in Heterodyne Displacement Measurement
abstract: The Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) frequency stabilization of an integrated semiconductor laser using an internal modulation is presented. A frequency noise suppression of 58dB is achieved. We further demonstrate how a stabilized and modulated carrier can be used in a high resolution Fabry Perot displacement sensor.

articleTitle: Monolithic Integrated Tunable Laser with a Surface Grating Antenna for High-Resolution Beamforming
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithically integrated tunable laser with a waveguide-based grating antenna capable of beamforming with full-width-half-maximum angular resolution of 0.064°.

articleTitle: Membrane Directly Modulated Lasers on Si Using Micro-Transfer Printing Integrated with Post-Processed Polymer Waveguide
abstract: We fabricate directly modulated membrane lasers by micro-transfer printing and integrate a single-mode polymer waveguide after printing. An InP inverse taper waveguide is used as a spot-size converter for the polymer waveguide. Fiber-coupled mW-class output power and 100-Gbit/s signal modulation are achieved.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated Multiwavelength Semiconductor Lasers for Optical I/O Applications
abstract: Semiconductor lasers play a pivotal role in modern optical I/O architectures, facilitating high-speed data transmission and communication. In this presentation, we will delve into Intel's groundbreaking developments in heterogeneously integrated laser technology, specifically tailored for the 300 mm silicon platform. This innovative technology not only promises enhanced performance and efficiency but also opens doors to new possibilities in data center networking, telecommunications, and beyond.

articleTitle: Enhanced Performance of 1.55-μm-Band QD-RSOA by Improving Injection Current Uniformity and Heat Dissipation through Wire Bonding
abstract: We have confirmed that wire bonding improves the I-L characteristics and mitigates the effects of self-heating in 1.55-µm band quantum dot reflective semiconductor optical amplifiers, and a heterogeneous laser coupled to a Si photonics chip shows improved optical output power and reduction in threshold current.

articleTitle: Key Factors Affecting Amplitude Modulated Frequency Combs in Interband Cascade Lasers
abstract: Group velocity dispersion, intraband relaxation, and nonradiative recombination are identified as some of the key factors that influence the potential operation of amplitude modulated frequency combs produced by two-section mid-infrared interband cascade lasers. A numerical model is used to suggest an optimized laser design by controlling the saturable absorber length and the waveguide group velocity dispersion.

articleTitle: Chip-Scale Random Number Generator Based On Self-Chaotic Dynamics Of Broad-Area VCSELs
abstract: We demonstrated a parallel chip-scale physical random number generator using the chaotic intensity from free-running broad-area VCSELs, where a single channel achieved 600 Gb/s, promising a compact, high-efficiency, and low-cost way for high-speed chip-integrated physical random number generation.

articleTitle: Wide Wavelength Tuning Range and High SMSR Operation of Hybrid Tunable Laser with InP Ridge/Si Slab Waveguide Structure
abstract: A new InP ridge/Si slab structure is introduced to a hybrid tunable laser by utilizing chip-on-wafer bonding. The laser achieves the SMSR of more than 53 dB and narrow spectral linewidth of less than 60 kHz over the entire tuning range of 56 nm.

articleTitle: Room-Temperature Continuous-Wave Operation of a Nanolaser with Extreme Dielectric Confinement
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate continuous-wave lasing at room temperature in a topology-optimized InP nanolaser with extreme dielectric confinement.

articleTitle: Development of All Group IV SiGeSn Mid Infrared Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report an electrically injected all-group-IV SiGeSn laser emitting at 2658 nm. At 77 K, the threshold is 800 A/ cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and peak power is 1.25 mW/facet. Laser operation is demonstrated up to 135 K. Enhanced lasing performance is achieved by increased optical and carrier confinements.

articleTitle: O-Band Laser Comb Source using Photonic Wire Bonding for Hybrid Integration
abstract: We demonstrate a 16-wavelength O-band laser comb source package for applications requiring short-reach wavelength division multiplexing. The comb consists of a 16x laser array multiplexed using a 16×16 silicon nitride waveguide star coupler. Hybrid integration and fiber coupling is achieved using photonic wire bonding.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of 940nm Laser Diode Pump Optimized for Performance at High Temperature
abstract: We demonstrate the suitability of activation energy and optical power acceleration to model laser diode reliability up to extremely high 155°C junction temperature. Values extracted from life tests are consistent with lower-stress literature values and confirms adequate reliability for commercial automotive LiDAR.

articleTitle: Relative Intensity Noise and Four Wave Mixing in Multimode Elliptical Oxide Aperture VCSELs
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically characterize multimode elliptical VCSELs. Relative Intensity Noise spectra reveal spurious peaks and optical spectra show four-wave-mixing sidebands limiting the performance. We explain, for the first time, these nontrivial characteristics, drawing guidelines for designing VCSELs with low RIN over the modulation bandwidth.

articleTitle: Achieving O-Band InAs Quantum Dot Laser Operation at 200 °C
abstract: We demonstrate O-band InAs quantum dot laser operation up to 202°C. A Fabry Perot laser device with as-cleaved facets and a co-doped scheme within the active region enables ultra-high temperature laser operation without requiring high-reflective facet coatings.

articleTitle: High-Power CW/Pulsed Operations of 1.55-µm-Wavelength Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers
abstract: We develop 1.55-µm InP-based photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers with double-lattice photonic-crystal structures. Single-mode continuous-wave lasing with 250-m W output power is achieved for a 200- µm -size device. Furthermore, under nanosecond pulsed conditions for a 400- µm -size device, we demonstrate a record-high output power exceeding 30 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$W$</tex> with a narrow divergence angle of approximately 1°.

articleTitle: Continuous-Wave Operation of 1D Photonic-Crystal Nanolasers on SiO2/Si at up to 100°C
abstract: We demonstrate continuous-wave operation of electrically-driven 1D photonic-crystal nanolasers on SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si at up to 100°C. The strong optical confinement, high-Q cavity, and appropriate wavelength detuning from the gain peak facilitate high-temperature operation, enabling us to achieve an ultralow threshold current of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{52}\ \boldsymbol{\mu} \mathbf{A}$</tex> at 100°C.

articleTitle: Study of Electrically Excited Photon-Photon Resonances in Self-Injection-Locked Coupled-Cavity VCSELs
abstract: We investigate photon-photon resonances in laterally coupled mini-arrays of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers under electrical excitation. We observe resonance peaks in the frequency response of the optical signal, which we investigate for each array element and spectral modes. Furthermore, we show self-injection locking with modulation bandwidth enhancement.

articleTitle: Lasing from InP Nanowire Hetero-PCSELs
abstract: The lasing characteristics from two nanowire hetero-PCSELs with hexagonally shaped inner arrays surrounded by an outer non-lasing array was investigated. The threshold reduction in one hetero-PCSEL is attributed to a feedback enhancement due to back reflection of the laser emission at the outer array boundary.

articleTitle: Hybrid III-V/Si Micro-Ring Laser with Non-Volatile Charge Trap Memory
abstract: We demonstrate hybrid III-V/Si microring lasers with optical non-volatility via co-integrated charge trap memory. Multi-state (4 states) optical memory is achieved with non-volatile duration up to 24 hours and most likely beyond.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of A Micro-Transfer Printed InP-On-Si3N4 Widely Tunable Laser
abstract: We demonstrate an InP-on-Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</inf> widely tunable laser on imec's 200-mm low-loss Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> platform through micro-transfer printing. The device shows a wavelength tuning range of 54 nm in C + L band with a side mode suppression ratio over 40 dB.

articleTitle: Frequency-Tunable Mode Locking in a Non Conventional DFB Laser
abstract: We present a new design of semiconductor mode-locked laser. It is based on a non-uniform DFB cavity engineered to support multiple equi-spaced optical modes. Moreover, we observe that the mode-locked frequency is broadly tunable, unlike traditional mode-locked lasers.

articleTitle: Buried Dielectric PCSELs
abstract: We propose using sub-micron buried dielectric features for low-index patterns within photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers (PCSELs). We show that replacing encapsulated voids with buried dielectric patterns could preserve the photonic crystal structure from mass transport deformation that may deteriorate the beam quality.

articleTitle: Self-Generation of Optical Frequency Combs in Hybrid III-V/SiN Integrated Tunable Lasers: Theory and Experiments
abstract: We experimentally observe the self-generation of optical frequency combs (OFCs) in hybrid integrated lasers with dispersive effective reflectivity implemented through coupled microrings in a SiN platform. We investigate and characterize the mechanism behind OFC formation. The observed OFC relaxes the requirement for high-Q rings.

articleTitle: High Brightness Coherent Photonic Crystal Surface-Emitting Laser Arrays
abstract: We report a novel design of coherent photonic crystal surface-emitting laser (PCSEL) array by passively coupling compact photonic crystal cavities in the lateral directions. Experimental characterization results show high beam quality and coherency from our fabricated laser array on InGaAs/GaAs multiple quantum well (MQW) platform.

articleTitle: 100Gbps/ch 1060nm Single-Mode Metal Aperture VCSEL Array at 85°C Operation
abstract: We present the 1000Gbps/ch 1060nm single-mode metal aperture VCSEL array. The modulation bandwidth is 27GHz with 7mA at 85°C. TDECQ of the 100Gbps PAM4 optical waveform is 3.0dB, 2km single-mode fiber transmission is demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-Speed InGaN/GaN Green Laser Diode for 17.73 Gbps Visible Light Communication
abstract: This study demonstrates a GaN-based green laser diode (LD) with a large modulation bandwidth of 3GHz (-3dB). Utilizing the high-speed LD as transmitter, a record data transmission rate of 17.73 Gbps has been achieved, with a bit error ratio (BER) of 3.4E-3.

articleTitle: Challenges for Room Temperature Electrically Injected GeSn Semiconductor Lasers
abstract: A group IV-based laser offers the possibility of fully CMOS compatible growth of integrated circuits for Si photonics. In this work, we use hydrostatic pressure measurements and temperature-dependent band structure modelling to assess processes limiting the operational temperature in electrically injected GeSn lasers.

articleTitle: Stabilized Optical Negative Feedback Lasers with Direct Current Modulation and Electrical Feedback
abstract: We demonstrate stabilized operation of an optical negative feedback laser consisting of InGaAsP-MQW DFB laser and Fabry-Perot etalon using a transmission-type Pound-Drever-Hall method with direct current modulation. We confirm three times higher suppression of low-frequency fluctuations even with the simple configuration.

articleTitle: Optical Feedback-Insensitive O-band Quantum Dot Comb Lasers
abstract: We report the quantum dot comb laser with 100 GHz spacing that can tolerate optical feedback up to at least -10 dB. Nevertheless, the external optical feedback could further suppress the low frequency relative intensity noise and narrow the pulse width of the comb laser.

articleTitle: Nanopyramid Semipolar Quantum Dot LED Through Selective Area Growth
abstract: We report the successful electrical operation of a nanopyramid semipolar quantum dot LED emitting at 455 nm. The quantum dots were formed by nano-scale selective area growth, while the cap layer was fabricated through two-step MOCVD growth.

articleTitle: High Performance Mid-infrared Interband Cascade Lasers on GaSb and Si Substrates
abstract: A comparison is made between static and dynamic properties of interband cascade lasers grown on GaSb and Si substrates at 3.3 µm, The latter demonstrates promising performance, suggesting future prospects for applications in free-space communications.

articleTitle: Dual DFB for Uncooled 40 Gbps and Cooled 72 Gbps Direct Modulation
abstract: We present an InP Ridge waveguide O-band Dual DFB for direct modulation applications. This DML operates uncooled up to 40 Gbps and cooled up to 72 Gbps. The Dual DFB utilizes the photon-photon resonance (PPR) to enhance the modulation bandwidth.

articleTitle: Highly Stacked Quantum Dot Mode-Locked Laser Diode with 100 GHz Mode Spacing
abstract: A <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{400}-\boldsymbol{\mu} \boldsymbol{m}$</tex> cavity length mode locked laser diode was fabricated with highly stacked quantum dot (QD) structure. Owing to the high density of QD, wide-band lasing with 100 GHz mode spacing was observed at 1550 nm wavelength range, which can be used for DWDM systems in fiber optic communications.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics Hybrid Tunable Laser Diode with Wavelength Tuning Range Exceeding 150 nm
abstract: We fabricated a silicon photonics hybrid wavelength-tunable laser using curved directional couplers with minimal wavelength dependency, achieving an exceptionally wide wavelength tuning range of 157.3 nm.

articleTitle: 225 Gb/s PAM4 EMLs for 800 Gb/s and 1.6T b/s Transceivers
abstract: We developed high-speed electro-absorption modulator integrated lasers (EMLs) with a hybrid waveguide structure and experimentally demonstrated 2-km and 10-km transmission operated at 225 Gb/s four-level pulse amplitude modulation (PAM4). Clear eye diagrams were observed over a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: A New Pathway to InP SWIR VCSELs Through Nanoporous Engineering
abstract: The absence of a manufacturable distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) mirror that is compatible with the high-gain active region has been a major obstacle in the commercialization of short-wave infrared (SWIR) VCSELs. To address this, we propose a conductivity-selective electrochemical porosification process which led to the realization of high-index-contrast InP DBRs. Furthermore, continuous-wave (CW) operation of NP-InP VCSELs were demonstrated at both 1,380 and 1,550 nm from two separate structures with milli-watts output power.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Circuit for NG-PON2 ONU Transmitter
abstract: Freedom Photonics has developed a Photonic Integrated Circuit transmitter chip that meets the stringent demands of the Next Generation Passive Optical Network 2 (NG-PON2) telecommunications standard. Our solution uses a wavelength tunable laser with monolithically integrated amplifier and electro absorption modulator to achieve this task.

articleTitle: Thermal Management for Wafer-Scale Heterogeneously Integrated InP Lasers on BCB
abstract: Heat dissipation from III-V based heterogeneously integrated lasers is challenging in the presence of the thermally isolating bonding layer. Herein, we explore two ways to improve heat dissipation of devices bonded with benzocyclobutene (BCB): bonding with ultra-thin BCB on a SiC substrate, and thick metal vias connecting lasers to a Si substrate, both resulted in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${2}\times$</tex> improved heat dissipation compared to devices without a conductive connection to the heat sink.

articleTitle: Multi-Tone Injection Locking of Three-Section AlGaInAS Mode-Locked Lasers for Space Applications
abstract: We fabricate and test the three-section mode-locked laser diode. The shortest pulse is 3.34ps with time-bandwidth product of 0.65. We conduct multi-tone injection locking which result in an RF linewidth reduction of 20× while maintaining the pulse width, with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{7}.\mathbf{62}\boldsymbol{\mu} \mathbf{W}$</tex> injection power at 1562nm.

articleTitle: Continuous Wave Operation of Electrically Pumped GeSn/SiGeSn Multiple Quantum Well Laser
abstract: A versatile electrically-pumped laser emitting at a near-infrared wavelength of 2.35 µm with a low threshold current of 4 mA is presented. It is based on a 6 periods SiGeSn/GeSn multiple quantum-well heterostructure and features a small footprint micro-disk cavity. The laser operates in continuous-wave (CW) regime but can also efficiently work in a direct modulation regime down to ns pulses. The impact of lattice temperature by electrical pumping due to the low thermal conductivity of the GeSn/SiGeSn on the performance is discussed.

articleTitle: 25-30 GHz Bandwidths for 980 nm VCSELs with Top MHCG Mirrors or Top Dielectric DBRs
abstract: We achieve record 25 GHz small-signal modulation bandwidths with top-emitting 980 nm vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs) that employ top coupling dielectric distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) mirrors or alternatively a DBR plus an etched sub-wavelength one-dimensional grating.

Author Keywords: monolithic high refractive index contrast gratings

articleTitle: 2-D Grating-Coupled Surface Emission from Phase-Locked Mid-IR Quantum Cascade Laser Array
abstract: Surface emission from a resonant leaky-wave coupled phase-locked array of mid-infrared (IR) quantum cascade lasers (QCLs) is achieved by using a metal/semiconductor 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order distributed feedback (DFB) grating placed in the array elements. A quasi-3D modal analysis is performed including lateral (i.e., array-mode) and longitudinal (i.e., DFB) directions to predict the threshold-current densities of the competing modes. The grating is found to improve the intermodal discrimination, ensuring single-spatial-mode operation to high surface-emitted output powers. Preliminary experimental results are 1 W surface-emitted power at 4.6 mm wavelength under pulsed-drive operation.

articleTitle: Development of PCSEL-Array Module Towards Metal 3D Printing Applications
abstract: We develop a PCSEL-array module towards metal 3D printing applications. We develop a module with four 3-mm-diameter PCSELs, which are mounted on a heat sink in a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{2}\times \mathbf{2}$</tex> arrangement while electrically connected in series, and achieve 200-W output power under CW conditions. This result suggests that the output power can be further increased to one kilowatt and beyond by increasing the number of PCSEL elements.

articleTitle: High-Power and Stable Operation of 1.31 $\mu\mathrm{m}\ \lambda/4$-Shifted DFB Laser Integrated with Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate high-power SOA-integrated DFB lasers. The lasing mode is stabilized by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\lambda}/{4}-{shifted}$</tex> grating structure. It exhibits an optical power of 300 mW and PCE of 23% at 50°C. Single-mode operation is confirmed across temperature range of 0 to 75°C.

articleTitle: Hybrid Integrated $2-3\ \mu \mathbf{m}$ Lasers for Miniaturized Spectral Sensors
abstract: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{2}-\mathbf{3}\ \boldsymbol{\mu} \mathbf{m}$</tex> wavelength range is highly interesting for multi-wavelength spectroscopy due to many applications in medical, industrial and environmental spaces. We advance the state-of-the-art in spectroscopic sensors and the related light sources by utilizing GaSb-based gain elements in conjugation with passive silicon photonics circuits. This approach allows a new type of scalable, miniaturized and configurable platform for preparing lasers with specific application targets. We aim to find more and more applications for spectroscopy, i.e. in wearables, by reducing sensor cost and increasing their functionality. We introduce our efforts in the development of integration technology, PIC design and III-V technology and present some of the state-of-the-art laser results in the field of hybrid laser technology. Example lasers feature wide continuous tuning, simplified discrete tuning to specific absorption line and in ultra-narrow linewidth laser operation.

articleTitle: On-Chip InAs QD Ring-Resonator Multi-Mode Interference Reflector Lasers for PICs
abstract: A compact on-chip laser that integrates a high-reflectivity MMIR and a ring-resonator on an InAs-QD platform is demonstrated. Such lasers offer significant benefits, including wavelength selectivity, fabrication tolerance, and simplified device fabrication through a single-step deep-etch waveguide process. The laser offers enhanced functionality for PICs.

articleTitle: Improving the Performance of Co-Doped 1300nm QD Lasers and Modulators
abstract: We report improvements to p-doped and co-doped quantum dot laser epi-structures. In integrated format, such epi-layers can be configured as lasers or electro-absorption modulators. Experimentally we see 20% lower threshold current at room temperature and modulator figure of merit that increases by a factor 3.

articleTitle: DFB Laser Sources Heterogeneously Integrated in Open Market Silicon Photonics Platform
abstract: We demonstrate the latest single-frequency Distributed Feedback (DFB) lasers heterogeneously integrated in an open market silicon photonics platform PH18DA at Tower Semiconductor.

articleTitle: High-Performance, Long-Wavelength Quantum Cascade Lasers with a Thin Modulation-Quantum-Well Structure
abstract: A quantum cascade laser design with wavefunction-expanded upper-laser-state using a thin modulation quantum well is proposed to clarify its own feasibility. l∼10.6 mm, as-cleaved QCLs employing the proposed active region design (94 stages) demonstrate high device performance: low threshold current density of 1.3 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> as well as a high peak output power of 2.0 W together with a slope efficiency of 2.2 W/A at room temperature from single facet, achieving a high wall-plug efficiency of 14.6% for total output powers. Continuous wave operation at room temperature has also successfully been demonstrated with a buried-heterostructure device with 50 stage active region.

articleTitle: Improved Thermal Performance of VCSELs on Germanium Substrates
abstract: VCSEL thermal resistances are determined from power-current-voltage-wavelength measurements performed on nominally identical epitaxial structures grown on Ge and GaAs substrates. It is shown, for the first time, that an improved thermal performance can be achieved through growth on Ge.

articleTitle: High-Power and High-Speed Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers (PCSELs) Based on Photon-Photon Resonance
abstract: We propose photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers based on photon-photon resonance to extend the direct modulation bandwidth. We experimentally demonstrate over 10-GHz direct modulation with over 1-W high output power under continuous-wave operation.

articleTitle: Peak Frequency Control of Photon-Photon Resonance GaInAsP Membrane DR Lasers on Si with Rear-Side Spacer Waveguide
abstract: A membrane DR laser with a rear-side spacer waveguide is demonstrated for precise control of peak resonant frequency of photon-photon resonance. The measurement results show that shortening the waveguide from 300 to 200 μm increased the peak resonant frequency from 15 to 21 GHz as expected.

articleTitle: Sharp Pulses in a Semiconductor Laser Array Subject to Optical Feedback and Transverse Coupling
abstract: We report on sharp pulses in an array of semiconductor lasers that are coupled via an external cavity. Analysis of the combined laser fields shows that a major drop of intensity occurs before pulses are triggered. Pulsing is thus preceded by a temporal destructive interference.

articleTitle: Toward High Performance Micro-Transfer Printed Quantum Dot Gain with Optimized Etched Facet Fabrication Process
abstract: A robust method is reported to deposit and characterize high-quality optical coatings on etched facets of quantum dot gain devices for micro-transfer printing on silicon nitride. A 0.6% reflectance for the anti-reflection coatings is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design and Demonstration of Lateral DBR Lasers Selectively Grown on SOI
abstract: We report Distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) lasers selectively grown on (001) silicon-on-insulator (SOI) wafers by lateral metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD). The optically pumped DBR lasers with five periods of Bragg reflectors demonstrate low lasing thresholds with an average value of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${12.8} \boldsymbol{\mu} {J}/{cm}^{{2}}$</tex> at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${1.5}\ \boldsymbol{\mu} {m}$</tex> band.

articleTitle: High Power High Efficiency Single Emitter Laser Diode with High Reliability Operation
abstract: To maximize output with low vertical divergence of single emitter laser diodes, epitaxial structures were designed and fabricated with two types of waveguide structures. At a driving current of 27 A under room temperature, high power of 27.9 W and high efficiency of 66.5% was achieved. The vertical far-field divergence angle with 95% power intensity of 47 ° was obtained. The aging test with temperature acceleration passed 3,500 hours without failure.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated Distributed Feedback Lasers at 980 nm
abstract: We present on-chip distributed feedback (DFB) diode lasers monolithically integrated on tantalum pentoxide (tantala) integrated photonic circuits. The DFB grating etched in tantala waveguides provide the necessary feedback for single mode lasing around 980 nm with 43 dB side mode suppression ratio and 300 GHz continuous mode-hop free tuning.

articleTitle: High-Power Operation of 376 nm Laser with GaN Waveguide
abstract: Over 3 W output power from a 376 nm laser incorporating GaN as a waveguide layer was demonstrated under pulse operation. Comparisons between cleaved and etched facet devices are presented.

articleTitle: Interband Cascade Lasers - From Theoretical Concept to Real-World Systems
abstract: Historical development of the ICL will be reviewed, from original theoretical concept in 1994, to incremental development culminating in its realization as a high-performance mid-IR source, to commercialization leading to implementation in real-world chemical sensing systems, and including recent NRL progress toward on-chip detection of chemical nerve agents.

articleTitle: 2-µm GaSb-Based Optically Pumped Semiconductor Membrane Laser (MECSEL)
abstract: We present the first diode-pumped GaSb-based semiconductor membrane laser directly bonded onto a SiC heatspreader with a continuous wave (cw) output power of 1.5 W at a center wavelength of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${2.08}\ \boldsymbol{\mu} {m}$</tex>, an optical-to-optical efficiency of 11.7% and thermal resistance of 0.74 K/W.

articleTitle: Welcome to the ISLC 2024
abstract: It is a great pleasure to welcome you to the 2024 29th International Semiconductor Laser Conference. The conference is held at the hotel Hilton Orlando Lake Buena Vista, near Orlando, Florida, USA following the ISLC tradition of cycling locations between the Americas, Asia/Australia and Europe/Mid-East/Africa regions every two years. Orlando is a hub for innovation and technology, and the conference location is near the world-renowned resorts and parks, as well as an hour's drive to the Cape Canaveral space port. The location of the venue offers, next to the hotel's excellent facilities, within walking distance a choice of restaurants and shops in Disney Springs from the conference venue to (continue) meetings with colleagues and friends.
